ideas.title: Recycling volumes → electronics demand
ideas.body: City e-waste tonnage is usually yearly (EPA ADEPT / Facts & Figures). Live proxy now on Amazon: U.S. paperboard mill production (FRED IPN32213N) plus cardboard box prices — packaging volume and price as a stand-in for goods moving through the system. True municipal recycling feeds stay 'ideas' until a free weekly national series appears.

ideas.title: Moth & pest counts → unsold inventory
ideas.body: The warehouse-moth anecdote never had a free national feed. FWS refuge moth inventories (data.gov) are one-off surveys, not a market series. Still an idea — we won't invent numbers.

ideas.title: Satellite parking-lot counts → store traffic
ideas.body: Commercial vendors (Orbital Insight-style) charge for car counts. Free Sentinel/Landsat revisit is too slow and cloudy for weekly retail traffic, and scraping Google Popular Times violates terms. Still an idea; no honest free substitute yet.

ideas.title: Fuel storage from satellites → oil inventories
ideas.body: Live now on ExxonMobil: weekly U.S. commercial crude stocks excl. SPR from the EIA (series WCESTUS1) — the official inventory print markets already watch. Satellite tank-farm estimates remain paid; the EIA series is the free, legal version of the same idea.
